{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = '999,999.99'
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Confirm the removal
print(f'After removing QA rows: {len(df_clean)} rows')

# Now check for any remaining commas in revenue
has_commas = df_clean['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Number of rows with commas in revenue after QA removal: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Look at a few examples
print('\nExamples of revenue values:')
print(df_clean['revenue'].head(10))"}
